*{box-sizing:border-box;} body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;font-size:14px;transition:background-color .15s ease,color .15s ease;} .app{display:grid;grid-template-rows:56px 1fr;height:100vh;} .topbar-global{grid-column:1/-1;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 20px;gap:16px;} .topbar-search{flex:1;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;} .topbar-search kbd{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text3);margin-left:auto;} .topbar-badge{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;} .topbar-avatar{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;} .aht-toggle-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text2);font-size:12.5px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:6px 12px;} .aht-switch{position:relative;display:inline-block;width:34px;height:19px;} .aht-switch input{opacity:0;width:0;height:0;} .aht-slider{position:absolute;cursor:pointer;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:var(--border);border-radius:20px;transition:.15s;} .aht-slider:before{position:absolute;content:"";height:14px;width:14px;left:3px;bottom:2.5px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;transition:.15s;} .aht-switch input:checked + .aht-slider{background:var(--accent);} .aht-switch input:checked + .aht-slider:before{transform:translateX(15px);} .aht-live-timer{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--warn);font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;} .aht-result-box{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;} .aht-result-box.efficient{border-color:var(--ok-border);background:var(--ok-bg);} .aht-result-box.acceptable{border-color:var(--warn-border);background:var(--warn-bg);} .aht-result-box.needs-improvement{border-color:var(--bad-border);background:var(--bad-bg);} .aht-result-box.qualified{border-color:var(--warn);background:var(--warn-bg);} .body-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:60px 280px 1fr 340px;grid-template-rows:1fr;overflow:hidden;min-height:0;} .icon-rail{background:var(--panel);border-right:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:14px 0;gap:6px;} .icon-rail .irow{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--text3);cursor:default;position:relative;} .icon-rail .irow.active{background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);} .icon-rail .irow svg{width:18px;height:18px;} .icon-rail .badge{position:absolute;top:-3px;right:-3px;background:var(--bad);color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;border-radius:10px;min-width:15px;height:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 3px;} .icon-rail .spacer{flex:1;} .icon-rail .rail-avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-top:6px;} .rail{background:var(--panel);border-right:1px solid var(--border);padding:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;} .rail .rail-header{padding:16px 16px 10px;} .rail h1{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 2px;font-weight:700;} .rail .sub{color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;} .queue-label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 16px 6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);} .queue-label .count{color:var(--text3);font-weight:400;} .skillgroup{margin-bottom:4px;padding:0 10px;} .skillgroup h2{font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--text3);margin:14px 6px 6px;} .scenario-card{background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 8px;margin-bottom:2px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .12s;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;} .scenario-card:hover{background:var(--panel2);} .scenario-card.active{background:var(--active-bg);border-color:var(--active-border);} .scenario-card .qavatar{flex-shrink:0;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;} .scenario-card .qbody{min-width:0;flex:1;} .scenario-card .title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:2px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;} .scenario-card .qsub{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text3);} .diff-pill{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;} .diff-Foundation{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok);} .diff-Applied{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);} .diff-Advanced{background:var(--bad-bg2);color:var(--bad);} .rg-pill{display:inline-block;font-size:9.5px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;background:var(--bad-bg2);color:var(--bad);margin-left:5px;} .diag-link-wrap{padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:auto;} .main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden;min-height:0;min-width:0;} .topbar{padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;} .topbar .who{font-weight:600;font-size:15px;} .topbar .status{font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);} .topbar .btns{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;} .topbar .chrome-icons{display:flex;gap:14px;color:var(--text3);margin-right:10px;} .topbar .chrome-icons svg{width:16px;height:16px;} button{font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--text);padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer;} button:hover{border-color:var(--accent);} button.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;} button.primary:hover{background:var(--accent2);} button.small{padding:4px 10px;font-size:11.5px;} button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;} .started-divider{text-align:center;margin:6px 0 18px;} .started-divider span{background:#eeeeee;border:1px solid #d8d8d8;color:#6b7280;font-size:11.5px;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:20px;} .prechat-card{background:#eeeeee;border:1px solid #d8d8d8;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:16px;max-width:78%;} .prechat-card .pctitle{color:#111318;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:10px;} .prechat-card .pcq{color:#8a919c;font-size:12.5px;margin-top:10px;} .prechat-card .pca{color:#111318;font-size:13.5px;margin-top:2px;} .chatlog{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;background:#f5f5f5;} .msg{max-width:62%;padding:11px 15px;border-radius:14px;line-height:1.45;} .msg .who{font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px;} .msg.player{align-self:flex-start;background:#e4e4e5;border:1px solid #d8d8d8;border-bottom-left-radius:4px;color:#111318;} .msg.player .who{color:#8a919c;} .msg.agent{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--agent);color:#fff;border-bottom-right-radius:4px;} .msg.agent .who{color:#c9d8ff;} .msg.system{align-self:center;color:#8a919c;font-size:12px;font-style:italic;background:none;border:none;} .typing{align-self:flex-start;color:#8a919c;font-size:12px;padding-left:4px;} .composer{padding:14px 20px;border-top:1px solid #d8d8d8;display:flex;gap:10px;background:#f5f5f5;} .composer textarea{flex:1;resize:none;background:#eeeeee;border:1px solid #d8d8d8;border-radius:10px;color:#111318;padding:11px 13px;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;height:44px;} .composer textarea::placeholder{color:#9aa1ab;} .composer textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);} .side{background:var(--panel);border-left:1px solid var(--border);padding:0;overflow-y:auto;} .side-icons{display:flex;gap:16px;padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text3);} .side-icons svg{width:17px;height:17px;} .side-identity{text-align:center;padding:22px 16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);} .side-identity .savatar{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin:0 auto 10px;} .side-identity .sname{font-weight:700;font-size:16px;} .side-identity .ssub{color:var(--text3);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:3px;} .side-section{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);} .side-section-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 16px;cursor:default;} .side-section-head h2{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);margin:0;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;} .side-section-head svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--text3);} .side-section-body{padding:0 16px 16px;} .info-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:6px 0;font-size:12.5px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);} .info-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;} .info-row .ilabel{color:var(--text3);} .info-row .ival{color:var(--text);text-align:right;} .box{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text2);} .box.title{color:var(--text);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;} .empty{color:var(--text3);font-size:13px;padding:20px 0;text-align:center;} .kb-banner{font-size:11px;color:var(--warn);border:1px solid var(--warn-border);background:var(--warn-bg);padding:6px 9px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.4;} .rg-banner{font-size:11px;color:var(--bad);border:1px solid var(--bad-border);background:var(--bad-bg);padding:6px 9px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:600;} .tab-group{margin-bottom:6px;} .tab-group .tab-name{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text2);margin:10px 0 5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;} .case-card{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;margin-bottom:7px;} .case-card .clabel{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:3px;} .case-card .cvalue{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5;} .case-card .gated-msg{font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);font-style:italic;} .modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:50;} .modal{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;max-width:760px;width:92%;max-height:86vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:26px 30px;} .modal h2{margin-top:0;} .rubric-row{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:14px 0;} .rubric-row .head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;} .rubric-row .label{font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;} .rubric-row .aiVal{font-size:12px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);} .rubric-row .aiVal.af{background:var(--bad-bg2);color:var(--bad);border-color:var(--bad-border2);font-weight:700;} .score-badge{font-size:38px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;} .score-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:4px;} .rubric-row .cite{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:8px;} .rubric-row select{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px;font-size:12.5px;font-family:inherit;} .rubric-row textarea.notes{width:100%;margin-top:6px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text);padding:7px 9px;font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;resize:vertical;min-height:36px;} .critical{color:var(--bad);font-weight:700;} .tag-autofail{background:var(--bad-bg2);color:var(--bad);border:1px solid var(--bad-border2);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;margin-left:8px;} .diag-section{border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:20px;padding-top:16px;} .diag-result{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;margin-top:10px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;} .diag-pass{color:var(--ok);font-weight:700;} .diag-fail{color:var(--bad);font-weight:700;} /* TL Management dashboard - collapsible top-level sections, same card language as .box elsewhere */ .dash-card{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:4px solid var(--section-accent, var(--border));border-radius:var(--radius);margin-bottom:18px;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;} .dash-card-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--section-accent, var(--text3)) 16%, transparent);color:var(--section-accent, var(--text3));} .dash-card-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:15px 18px;cursor:pointer;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;} .dash-card-header:hover{background:var(--hover-tint);} .dash-card-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0;} .dash-card-arrow{display:inline-block;color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;transition:transform .15s ease;flex-shrink:0;} .dash-card-arrow.open{transform:rotate(90deg);} .dash-card-header h2{margin:0;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:15px;color:var(--text);overflow-wrap:break-word;} .dash-card-summary{color:var(--text3);font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;} .dash-card-body{padding:0 18px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:18px;} .dash-subsection{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;margin-top:18px;overflow:hidden;} .dash-subsection-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 14px;cursor:pointer;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;background:var(--panel);} .dash-subsection-header:hover{background:var(--hover-tint);} .dash-subsection-header h3{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:break-word;} .dash-subsection-body{padding:14px;} /* .main's width is whatever's left after the fixed-width rail/scenario-list/side-panel columns, so this keys off viewport width as a proxy for "the TL Management column is getting tight" - covers common smaller-laptop resolutions (1024x768 and similar), not just phone widths. */ @media (max-width:900px){ .dash-card-summary{display:none;} .dash-card-header h2{font-size:14px;} } .category-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:14px;max-width:900px;} .category-tile{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:18px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .1s;} .category-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--accent);} .category-tile-icon{margin-bottom:10px;} .category-tile-title{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:4px;} .category-tile-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);} .home-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--hero-grad-1) 0%,var(--hero-grad-2) 65%);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:32px 34px;margin-bottom:28px;max-width:900px;} .home-hero-eyebrow{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent2);margin-bottom:10px;} .home-hero h1{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:26px;line-height:1.3;} .home-hero-sub{color:var(--text2);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.65;max-width:640px;} .home-hero-stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:20px;} .home-stat-chip{background:var(--chip-tint);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;} .home-stat-chip strong{color:var(--text);font-weight:700;} .category-scenario-card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:10px;max-width:700px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .1s;} .category-scenario-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
